representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript --vanilla - "$(inputs.count_matrix.path)" "$(inputs.sample_sheet.path)" results.tsv summary.tsv <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
count_path <- args[[1]]
sample_path <- args[[2]]
result_path <- args[[3]]
summary_path <- args[[4]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(apeglm)
  library(BiocParallel)
})

workers <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("GALAXY_SLOTS", "1")))
if (is.na(workers) || workers < 1L) workers <- 1L
if (workers > 1L) register(MulticoreParam(workers))

counts_df <- read.table(
  count_path,
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "",
  quote = "",
  comment.char = "",
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (ncol(counts_df) < 2L) stop("Count matrix must contain a gene ID column and sample columns")
gene_id <- counts_df[[1]]
if (anyDuplicated(gene_id)) stop("Gene identifiers are duplicated")
rownames(counts_df) <- gene_id
counts_df[[1]] <- NULL

sample_info <- read.delim(
  sample_path,
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
required_cols <- c("sample", "sex", "condition")
if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(sample_info))) stop("Sample sheet lacks required columns")
if (anyDuplicated(sample_info$sample)) stop("Sample identifiers are duplicated")
if (!all(sample_info$sample %in% colnames(counts_df))) stop("A sample-sheet sample is absent from the count matrix")

count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_df[, sample_info$sample, drop = FALSE])
storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
if (anyNA(count_mat) || any(count_mat < 0L)) stop("Counts must be nonnegative integers")
if (!identical(colnames(count_mat), sample_info$sample)) stop("Count and metadata sample order mismatch")

sample_info$sex <- factor(sample_info$sex)
sample_info$condition <- factor(sample_info$condition, levels = c("Control", "ASXL1"))
if (anyNA(sample_info$condition)) stop("Unexpected condition level")
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ sex + condition
)
dds <- DESeq(dds, parallel = workers > 1L)
coef_name <- "condition_ASXL1_vs_Control"
if (!(coef_name %in% resultsNames(dds))) {
  stop(paste("Required coefficient missing. Available:", paste(resultsNames(dds), collapse = ",")))
}
unshrunk <- results(
  dds,
  name = coef_name,
  alpha = 0.05,
  independentFiltering = TRUE,
  cooksCutoff = TRUE
)
shrunk <- lfcShrink(
  dds,
  coef = coef_name,
  res = unshrunk,
  type = "apeglm",
  parallel = workers > 1L
)
if (!("pvalue" %in% names(shrunk))) shrunk$pvalue <- unshrunk$pvalue
if (!("padj" %in% names(shrunk))) shrunk$padj <- unshrunk$padj

out <- data.frame(
  geneID = rownames(shrunk),
  baseMean = shrunk$baseMean,
  log2FoldChange = shrunk$log2FoldChange,
  lfcSE = shrunk$lfcSE,
  pvalue = shrunk$pvalue,
  padj = shrunk$padj,
  check.names = FALSE
)
write.table(out, result_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")

sig_count <- sum(!is.na(shrunk$padj) & shrunk$padj < 0.05)
summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "significant_genes_padj_lt_0.05",
    "genes_in_input",
    "samples_analyzed",
    "control_samples",
    "asxl1_samples",
    "design",
    "contrast",
    "results_alpha",
    "lfc_shrinkage",
    "DESeq2_version",
    "apeglm_version"
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(sig_count),
    as.character(nrow(count_mat)),
    as.character(ncol(count_mat)),
    as.character(sum(sample_info$condition == "Control")),
    as.character(sum(sample_info$condition == "ASXL1")),
    "~ sex + condition",
    coef_name,
    "0.05",
    "apeglm",
    as.character(packageVersion("DESeq2")),
    as.character(packageVersion("apeglm"))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary, summary_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
cat("completed coefficient", coef_name, "significant genes", sig_count, "\n")
RSCRIPT
